source_title: Got My First Paying Customer 2 Days After Launch Wasnt Where I Expected D905B39341
snippet_primary: "On Wednesday morning, while brewing coffee, an alert pops up - Payhip notifies me. A customer signed up for the monthly package costing forty-nine bucks. I honestly believed it was junk mail or some trial charge I'd overlooked. Looked into it again - twice more - to be sure. Nope. Actual buyer. Seems they arrived via SaaSHub, judging by the ref link - though truthfully, I can't say for certain; Payhip's logs aren't that clear."
subject_exact: Developer reports first Payhip subscription sale ($49/month) 2 days after launch — likely attributed to SaaSHub referral though Payhip attribution logs described as unclear
metric_unit: USD per month (first subscription sale, monthly package)
parser_notes: Indie Hackers forum (December 11, 2025). Developer reports first Payhip sale 2 days after launch: $49/month subscription, likely from SaaSHub referral. Notes Payhip attribution logs are unclear. Anecdotal early-traction story.
